preconditions.expression: len(S) >= 1 and len(S) <= 10**5 and all(c in 'ABC' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The source string S has length between 1 and 10^5 and contains only characters 'A', 'B', 'C'.

preconditions.expression: len(T) >= 1 and len(T) <= 10**5 and all(c in 'ABC' for c in T)
preconditions.description: The target string T has length between 1 and 10^5 and contains only characters 'A', 'B', 'C'.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= b <= len(S) and 1 <= c <= d <= len(T) for a, b, c, d in queries)
preconditions.description: For every query (a, b, c, d), the indices are valid 1-based ranges within S and T respectively.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == Q and all(ch in '01' for ch in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output is a string of length Q consisting only of '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == '1') == is_reachable(S[a-1:b], T[c-1:d]) for i, (a, b, c, d) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the i-th character is '1' if and only if the substring T[c..d] can be obtained from S[a..b] using the allowed transitions, and '0' otherwise.
